LBR.note: The ERP is part of the Liberia Revenue Authority's own agenda; no national digital strategy stated.

facts.fact: The Liberia Revenue Authority's new ERP platform was developed entirely by the Authority's in-house information technology professionals.
The LRA's in-house-built ERP, begun in July 2025, was launched at an activation ceremony and runs in parallel with manual processes for a three-month transition.
The LRA ERP was developed entirely by the Authority's own IT staff, with no contractor named.
